1.20.1.0.2.0: Adds expandable fluid multiblock factories, configurable item/fluid/energy ports, upgrade cores, dynamic GUIs, and complete JEI integration.
1.20.1.0.2.1: Fixes Mekanical Create machines and multiblock components not dropping when mined with a pickaxe.
1.20.1.0.2.2: Adds automatic Create-addon recipe discovery, KubeJS recipe support, native FE item charging, and lowers the minimum supported Forge version to 47.1.7.
1.20.1.0.2.3: Fixes a stack overflow when recursive generic signatures from Create addons are inspected during recipe discovery.
1.20.1.0.2.4: Adds deterministic equal-priority recipe rotation and Create Sifter compatibility.
1.20.1.0.2.5: Adds tier-based factory parallelism, uncapped multiblock speed and energy cores, fan batch processing, and persistent machine contents when dismantled.

1.21.1.0.2.0: Adds expandable fluid multiblock factories, configurable item/fluid/energy ports, upgrade cores, dynamic GUIs, and complete JEI integration.
1.21.1.0.2.1: Fixes Mekanical Create machines and multiblock components not dropping when mined with a pickaxe.
1.21.1.0.2.2: Adds automatic Create-addon recipe discovery, KubeJS recipe support, native FE item charging, and lowers the minimum supported NeoForge version to 21.1.219.
1.21.1.0.2.3: Fixes a stack overflow when recursive generic signatures from Create addons are inspected during recipe discovery.
1.21.1.0.2.4: Adds deterministic equal-priority recipe rotation and Create Sifter compatibility.
1.21.1.0.2.5: Adds tier-based factory parallelism, uncapped multiblock speed and energy cores, fan batch processing, and persistent machine contents when dismantled.
1.21.1.0.2.6: Uses native Create fan timing, pauses fan progress when outputs are blocked, and sizes each fan batch to the four real output slots without losing items.
